rows.finding: PI reports annual mass releases to air, controlled waters and sewers.
The gas-emissions gate accepts only direct releases to air.
C is a valid calculated determination method.
E is a valid estimated determination method.
M is a valid measured determination method.
U is a valid unspecified determination method.
Missing or below-threshold PRTR data is NO_DATA and is not inferred as zero.
Waste and wastewater transfers remain separate from direct environmental releases.
Facility identity and reporting year are required for a facility release record.
A pollutant identity is required for an annual release record.
Accept kg, kilogram, kilograms, kg/year and kg/yr as annual mass units.
Accept tonne, tonnes, metric tonne, t/year and t/yr as annual mass units.
Accept g, gram, grams, g/year and g/yr as annual mass units.
Normalize tonnes to kilograms with factor 1000.
Normalize grams to kilograms with factor 0.001.
Preserve original numeric value and original unit beside normalized kg/year.
Reject concentration units such as mg/m3 and ng/m3.
Reject concentration units such as ppm.
Reject volumetric-rate units such as m3/hour.
Reject power units such as MW and MWe.
Reject duration-only units such as hours.
Reject negative release values.
Accept explicit zero only when the official source explicitly reports numeric zero.
Reject non-finite values and non-numeric placeholders.
Require an explicit UK PRTR or Environment Agency Pollution Inventory source.
Reject water, land, sewer and transfer media from the gas-emissions output.
Reject an unknown determination method when a method code is supplied.
Emit canonical normalized_kg_per_year for accepted rows.
Keep every accepted facility release unbound to parcels until verified geometry exists.
Never create a synthetic zero row when a facility or pollutant is absent.

quality_gate: Only official annual air-release mass values are normalized. Raw value and unit are preserved; NO_DATA is never converted to zero; parcel binding remains pending verified geometry.
